notes.title: 😺Contest - win 4 steam keys for full version of Catnight

😻Rules😻    
Use #catnightgame and post on Twitter screenshot or video of you playing Catnight. You can mention us @Catnighgame, to make the tweet more visible to us. We will choose randomly 3 persons who will win 4 keys. The deadline is the 4th of February at 11.49 pm PT. [b]More posts, the greater chance to win. [/b]
